help.p1: "Drip content" locks a lesson until a condition is met:
help.p2: (Relative) means the lesson unlocks for each student a specific number of days after their own purchase date; ideal for week-by-week delivery (each person counts from their own day).
help.p3: (Fixed) means the lesson unlocks for everyone on the exact same calendar date; ideal for simultaneous/cohort courses with a shared calendar.
help.p4: Locks the lesson until the minimum required score is achieved on a preceding quiz; this means a mastery-based learning path: until the previous stage's quiz is passed, the next stage remains locked. These conditions combine with the sequential prerequisite of the lesson, and all must be met for the lesson to unlock. The lock is enforced entirely server-side; locked lesson content cannot be played even if bypassed.
help.title: What is drip content?

s2.heading: 2 · Initial Curriculum
s2.lead: Build the course skeleton: you can use AI to generate a complete draft (module ← lesson ← section) and review it before applying, or manually add module titles for now. This step is optional and can also be completed later in the "Modules" tab.

s3.assessBody: In the "Assessments" tab, you can create practices and quizzes for the course (14 question types, question bank, timed exams) and connect them to the entire course, a module, or a lesson — use "Practice" mode for free repetition, or "Required" mode as a progress condition for buyers.
s3.heading: 3 · Section Content
s3.lead: The content for each section (video, slide, document, audio, H5P interactive content, text, link, or quiz) is uploaded in the "Content" tab of the course studio; there you will see the list of all sections with their "Has Content / No Content" status and can complete them one by one. For video recording, the browser-based "Recording Studio" is also available (camera, screen, or both).
s3.note: You can skip this step and complete the content later — the course will not be published until you click "Submit for Review".

s4.heading: 4 · Pricing
s4.lead: Choose whether the course is "Free" or "One-time Purchase". You can change the price later; the amount paid by each buyer is locked at the moment of purchase.

s5.heading: 5 · Publishing Checklist
s5.lead: "Required" items must be completed before "Submit for Review"; "Recommended" items improve the quality of the course page. Each item can be completed from within the course studio.
s5.ready: The course is ready for submission — submit it from the top studio bar.
